source_span: the front end is anchored by a Fed on hold, so the long end is doing the work as term premium rebuilds ... a soft print would not by itself reverse it while the Fed stays on hold
source_chain: 10-year breaks 4.40% Friday, therefore (Fed on hold pins the front end) the move is a bear-steepener driven by term premium rebuilding rather than hike fear, therefore JPM pays 5s30s at 62bp/stop 48bp (Citi dissents: positioning flush, holds 4.40% on close); invalidation: hot core PCE Thursday (0.3% consensus) validates the steepener, a soft print does not reverse it while the Fed stays on hold.
